summary: LiteLLM 1.107.0 wheels on PyPI and the matching official images carried a credential stealer (cook.pth) and a remote code loader (sitecustomize.py). The release was removed from PyPI and the poisoned tags were yanked.
remediation: Remove cook.pth, cook.py, and sitecustomize.py before starting Python again. Pin litellm==1.106.2 and rebuild images from a clean tree. Rotate credentials the host could reach.
